RESULT [attribution]: From the HTML version: the first-order variant runs very close to plain training time and the second-order variant is about 2x slower. About 16% of the Pile (GPT-2 pretraining) received negative value, and removing it reached a test loss of 3.75 in about 25% fewer iterations.
US [attribution]: Because values accumulate per iteration against a chosen validation set, each increment's fine-tune can log the summed value of the new batch's images against a species-balanced cwd12-val slice at little extra cost. A strongly negative batch total flags a rollback before any seed ablation is paid for. It is still single-run and subject to the seed-noise caveat above, so use it for triage, not as t [note truncated at collection]
